profile.label: Profile
profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarDescription: Shown next to your name in comments, assignees, and members.
profile.avatarFormats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF.
profile.detailsDescription: Your name appears across the app. Sign in with your username or email.
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, and underscores. 3 to 30 characters.

security.label: Security
security.title: Security
security.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in without a password using Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key.
security.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without a password.
security.deleteWarning: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. This cannot be undone.
security.connectedAppsDescription: Applications such as Claude or ChatGPT that you allowed to act on your behalf through MCP. They see and do what you can.
security.connectedAppsEmpty: No application is connected to your account.
security.disconnectAppWarning: It loses access at once. Connecting it again will ask for your consent again.
security.confirmSessionDescription: Adding a passkey gives access to {email}. Confirm your identity to continue. You do not need to sign out.
security.confirmSessionLoadFailed: Could not load sign-in methods. Close this dialog and try again.
security.confirmSessionFailed: Could not confirm your identity. Try again.
security.confirmLinkSent: A sign-in link was sent to {email}. Open it to return to Security, then choose Add passkey.
security.sessionConfirmed: Identity confirmed. Choose Add passkey to create your key.
security.confirmSessionUnavailable: No sign-in method is currently available to confirm your identity. Contact your instance administrator.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Accounts you sign in with, and your accounts on repository hosts.
accounts.googleDescription: Sign in with your Google account.
accounts.repositoryAccountDescription: Act in repositories on your behalf.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How the app looks and works for you.

sections.issueSettingsDescription: Defaults for every issue you open. Changing them on an open issue does not change these.
sections.shortcutsDescription: The reset button returns a shortcut to its default.

preferences.themeDescription: Match system follows your operating system setting.
preferences.paletteDescription: Each palette has a light and a dark version.
preferences.accentDescription: The color of buttons, links, and selected items.
preferences.backgroundDescription: A dark color gives a dark theme, a light color a light one.
preferences.contrastDescription: How much text and borders stand out from the background.
preferences.sharePaletteDescription: Copy this palette to send it. Paste applies a palette from the clipboard.
preferences.pastePaletteInvalid: The clipboard has no palette. Copy one first, then paste it.
preferences.languageDescription: The language of the interface, your emails, and the Telegram bot.
preferences.timezoneDescription: Dates and times across the app show in this zone.
preferences.startPageDescription: Opens in the project you used last.
preferences.statsViewDescription: Compact bar shows the share of time in each status. Timeline gives each status its own lane.
preferences.activityViewDescription: Grouped by status splits entries by the status the issue had at the time.
preferences.showChatByDefaultDescription: The chat panel opens with every project page.
preferences.agentRunsViewDescription: Full opens a run beside the list. Compact opens it in place of the list. Phones always use compact.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Your Inbox gets every event. Choose which ones are also sent outside the app.
notifications.defaultsDescription: For every project you have not changed, including new ones.
notifications.applyToAllText: {count, plural, one {# project loses its own settings.} other {# projects lose their own settings.}}
notifications.appliedToAll: All projects now use the defaults
notifications.telegramWaiting: Waiting for you to press Start in the bot chat…
notifications.slackConnectCancelled: The connection was cancelled in Slack. Connect again from your notification settings.
notifications.pushDescription: This browser, even when the app is closed
notifications.pushUnsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
notifications.pushUnsupportedIos: On an iPhone or iPad, add the app to the Home Screen, then turn this on there. Needs iOS 16.4 or later.
notifications.pushFailed: Could not change push notifications in this browser. Try again.
notifications.desktopDescription: This browser, while the app is open
notifications.desktopUnsupported: This browser cannot show desktop notifications.
notifications.browserBlocked: This browser blocks notifications from this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings.
notifications.selected: {count, plural, one {# project selected} other {# projects selected}}
notifications.editText: {count, plural, =1 {Replaces the settings in this project.} other {Replaces the settings in these projects.}}
notifications.projectsUseDefaults: {count, plural, one {# project now uses the defaults} other {# projects now use the defaults}}
notifications.turnedOff: Notifications turned off in {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}
notifications.projectsSaved: Settings saved in {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}
notifications.autoWatchDescription: Issues you create, comment on, are assigned to, or are mentioned in.
